reasoning: I fitted each entity's reported events to the seven known causal chains and judged genuineness on whether a real propagation is actually underway rather than on raw volume. Positive evidence: all of the entity's events belong to ONE chain and occupy a contiguous (or near-contiguous) stretch of it; their first-seen days increase monotonically along the chain's direction with plausible step lags of weeks, not zero days and not inversions; independent_sources equals total_reports (no echo), so corroboration is real rather than the same complaint re-filed; the reports span many distinct sites and regions; there are no contradicting reports; and, critically, the DOWNSTREAM end of the chain is still live near day 179 rather than having gone quiet. Negative evidence used to demote: events drawn from several unrelated chains (coincidence grab-bags, e.g. C-16 whose seven events fit only two positions of any one chain); total_reports far exceeding independent_sources (duplicated chatter, e.g. C-52 39/17, C-1 25/10, C-10, C-51); effects logged before their causes or all events bursting within a few days so no propagation can have occurred (C-9, C-43, C-38, C-22); stale or closed-out situations whose last report is months old (C-43 d84, C-30 d94, C-8 d99, C-32 d118) or whose upstream chatter continues while the consequence end died (C-25, C-45, C-11); contradiction flags; and structurally perfect chains carried by a single reporter at a single site (C-4, C-37, C-3, C-21), which is one person's narrative, not cross-organisational corroboration. I escalate only candidates that clear every positive test simultaneously.
